This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (for short "Act of 1988") has been preferred by the appellants/claimants seeking enhancement of amount of compensation,
challenging the impugned award dated 23/08/2018 passed by learned 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raigarh (C.G.) in Claim Case No. 74/2016, whereby learned Claims Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs. 11,40,000/- as compensation to the appellants/claimants for the death of Kanhaiyalal Sone.
2.

entities.text: 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellants/claimants would submit that while computing compensation,
the Claims Tribunal has not granted any sum for future prospect whereas it ought to have granted 40% of the annual income as future prospect.

Further  th deduction ought to have been made towards personal expenses instead of 1/3rd and the Claims Tribunal has also not granted anything under loss of consortium whereas it ought to have granted Rs. 40,000/- x 4 = Rs. 2,00,000/- under loss of consortium, as such, the amount of compensation may suitably be enhanced.

3. Learned counsel for respondent No. 3 would support the impugned award and submit that the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no interference by this Smt.Jamuna Bai Sone vs Rajesh Kumar Dangi on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89352207/
2 Court.
4.

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties, considered their rival submissions made herein-above and went through the records with utmost circumspection.

5. Considering the submission made by learned counsel for the appellants as well as after perusal of the record as well as the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is computing the compensation as below:-
Sr. Heads Compensation Compensation No. awarded by the awarded by this Court Tribunal 1.
Income

5 . Loss of Consortium NIL Rs. 40,000/- x 4 = Rs. 2,00,000/-
6.

Funeral Expenses Rs. 10,000/- Rs. 10,000/-
7. Love and Affection Rs. 10,000/- x 5 = NIL Rs. 50,000/-
Total Rs. 11,40,000/- Rs. 18,71,000/-
6.
In view of the aforesaid analysis, the amount of compensation of Rs. 11,40,000/- awarded by the Claims Tribunal is enhanced to Rs. 18,71,000/-.
Hence, the appellants/claimants are held entitled for an additional amount of Rs. 7,31,000/-.
Respondent No. 3 is directed to deposit the amount of compensation as enhanced by this Court within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
The additional amount of compensation shall carry interest @ 8% per annum from the date of filing of claim application before the Tribunal i.e. 12/07/2016 till its realization.
Rest of the conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
7. Accordingly, this appeal is allowed and the impugned award is modified to the extent as indicated herein-above.

Sd/-
